thread:
linh: Quick pass on the compact dashboard dark-mode UI — noticed two eyeflow problems: sparklines vanish on the surface gradient, and the token heatmap isn't distinguishable for a few color-blind palettes. Sharing a tiny palette proposal and notes.

mara: thanks — can you drop the hexes here? :eyes:

linh: sure, pasted below. this is just a starting point; I'm trying to keep saturation low so the chart colors don't fight with text.

linh: ```
/* background / surfaces */
--bg: #0e1114; /* main page bg */
--surface: #121416; /* panels */
--muted-text: #9aa3ad;

/* accents */
--brand: #6ec3ff; /* primary */
--accent-1: #7de3b8; /* success-ish */
--accent-2: #ffd47d; /* warning/heat */

/* charts */
--sparkline: rgba(110,195,255,0.55);
--heat-low: #5fb0c7; --heat-med: #ffd47d; --heat-high: #ff7a5a;
```

jon: I like the muted text + brand pairing. Quick thought — sparkline alpha at 0.55 still disappears on the darker panel shadows. Can we bump to 0.85 or do a 1px glow?

priya: also tagging accessibility: body copy needs 4.5:1 against --surface. Our token percentages and small labels are failing contrast checks in the mock. For small text we need stronger contrast or larger type.

sasha: heatmap colors: high = #ff7a5a looks ok, but med and low are too close for deuteranopia. Suggest either switch to a blue->yellow scheme or add a pattern/texture overlay for low values so it's not purely hue-dependent.

linh: good call. proposal: keep high as warm, move low to a desaturated blue-green and med to a bright yellow. also add optional hatch overlay when 'color-blind mode' enabled. Example updated:```
--heat-low: #4fb6aa;
--heat-med: #ffd47d;
--heat-high: #ff7a5a;
```

mara: love the toggle idea. copy suggestion for settings: "Heatmap: Color + pattern (recommended for color-blind viewers)" or shorter: "Heatmap: high-contrast patterns"

jon: small UI nit — the token legend labels are inline and wrap awkwardly in compact layout. If we collapse legend into a tooltip on hover and show an abbreviated key in the header we save ~40px and the chart breathes.

priya: agreed on legend. also make sure the selectable legend items have clear focus styles (outline) for keyboard users. 3:1 focus ring for interactive elements is the minimum.

linh: ack. plan:
- Bump sparkline opacity to 0.85 and add a subtle outer-glow on hover.
- Swap heatmap low->med hues as above and add pattern overlay opt-in.
- Move legend to collapsible tooltip in compact mode.
- Adjust text sizes where contrast fails and add a11y notes in the spec.

sasha: can you add a tiny screenshot or Figma frame link? seeing the texture overlay will help decide if it's too noisy for small cells. :thumbsup:

design-bot: New frame uploaded: https://figma.com/file/abcd-compact-dark-heatmap (linh/compact-dark-mode-pass)

linh: added screenshot and updated figma. I'll open a small PR with CSS variables + a test fixture (compact dashboard story) so QA can toggle color-blind mode.

mara: copy tweak: change the settings label from "Color-blind mode" to "Accessibility: Heatmap patterns" — avoids othering language and is clearer.

priya: yes, wording change approved. please also add a short tooltip: "Improves contrast for color-vision differences."

linh: will do. thanks team — I'll follow up with PR link and the accessibility checklist results. :white_check_mark:
